topic: What happens after you hire us

slides.headline: What actually happens after you hire us, start to finish
You send the link.
slides.body: The review and where it's posted. That's all we need to start.

slides.headline: We tell you straight whether we'll take it.
slides.body: Before anything is agreed or signed.

slides.headline: One fixed fee, in writing.
slides.body: Agreed per review before work starts. No retainer, no hourly billing.

slides.headline: Our specialists handle every step.
slides.body: You never fill in a form or chase anyone.

slides.headline: We watch it for you.
slides.body: Platforms rarely send a verdict, so we track it until it's resolved and report back.

slides.headline: You pay when it's gone.
slides.body: Not before. If it stays up, you owe nothing.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
